notes.title: New Update: "Monkeys and Typewriters" Now Includes Drawing Mode!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to introduce Drawing Mode in Monkeys and Typewriters! Now, your monkey can imagine unique illustrations for each chapter of your story. Every chapter will come to life with its own image, adding a creative twist to your narrative. 

To get started, your monkey will need 4 bananas 🍌 to begin this new creative journey.
Ready to see your story in pictures? Choose the Drawing Mode below your prompt and let your monkey’s imagination take over!
Thanks for being part of the adventure – we can’t wait to see what you create!

notes.title: Now you can set genre for your story!
notes.notes: We just added an option to choose from different genres when creating a new story! Have fun experimenting with more possibilities!

notes.title: Players, create your own stories please!
notes.notes:
Hello anyone who played with monkey:
Our game is mainly about creating your own story with AI and make a simulation game with several lines of description! So please don't just stop after the first hamlet tutorial, try your own story for at least once!
